searchText: Could we just delete the builder onboarding on the fork? It introduces nasty complexities like https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/10569 for the record I support this and asked why it was being introduced at the time people seemed to find it unacceptable to go 2 epochs without, so whatever there's also one-time-use cache checking jank I'm a bit worried of removing this capability so late in the fork. Also we have now communicated pretty heavily that onboarding at fork would be possible. This seems like a very narrow edge case it was and is pointless and people thought it was simple until it wasn't, usual story I don't think its pointless. Not breaking user applications for 12 mins is not really "pointless" it's already possible for builders to just not work it's not part of consensus spec today Yeah but have we seen 2 epochs of only locally built blocks? and builder API would still be there it's just p2p builders which wouldn't lots of applications rely on private order flow, which relies on builders which are a new thing anyway how would builder api work? wouldn't that also require a registered builder? ah, right, ok, it wouldn't, it still needs the hook Nah, the builder API doesn't work i dont think it makes sense to allow for 2 epochs of local blocks. that seems bad
